notes: The list already covers Suk's core violin output: the Fantasy Op. 24, the Four Pieces Op. 17 (complete and single movements), the Love Song arrangement and the queued Bagatelle. I have added nothing, because I could not confirm a published edition for any other early violin-and-piano pieces I half-recall (e.g. a Ballade c. 1890). The Elegie Op. 23 (piano trio/ensemble), the Op. 3 cello pieces and the string quartets are out of scope.
